name: Gus Bilirakis
page_title: Gus Bilirakis' Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (FL) - District 12

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Today is the 2nd anniversary of the Dobbs vs. Jackson Supreme Court ruling overturning Roe vs. Wade and paving the way for states to enact laws that better protect the lives of unborn children. I remain unapologetically pro-life and will continue to fight for the unborn!"
Rated 100% by Campaign for Working Families in 2019-20
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee in 2023-24
Voted in favor of HR 26 "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act" in 2023
Do you generally support pro-choice or pro-life legislation? "Pro-life; I always support pro-life measures."

positions.question: Do you support economic intervention as a means of resolving international conflicts?

evidence.text: "I applaud the President’s decision to re-impose sanctions against Iran, a known bad actor on the international stage and state sponsor of terrorism. I've consistently supported sanctions against Iran and other hostile countries, like Russia and N. Korea."

"Iran could be close to having nuclear capabilities. Instead of harsh sanctions against Iran, Biden announced he would waive sanctions on non-military international cooperation with Iran’s nuclear program. We cant afford weakness against known adversaries."
Voted in favor of HR 7108 "Suspending Normal Trade Relations with Russia and Belarus Act" in 2022
Voted in favor of HR 8034 "Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you support the US providing increased offensive military aid to Ukraine?

evidence.text: "I have extreme compassion for Ukrainians and abhor Putin's illegal war, but I've been a strong opponent of continued U.S. funding for Ukraine. There's no accountability for funds, no exit strategy & we have our own dire national security needs to fund."

"Of course I support the people of Ukraine as they fight back against a brutal Russian invasion, however, Americans deserve transparency and accountability for how their tax dollars are being spent as well as a well-thought out exit strategy."
Voted against HR 5692 "Ukraine Security Assistance and Oversight Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"
Voted against HR 8035 "Ukraine Security Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"
